name: @kefli/extension
description: The Kefli browser extension: Chrome and Firefox from one codebase (extension spec, contract v1.12 section 4.4)

scripts.firefox: node build.mjs dev && web-ext run --source-dir dist/dev-firefox --firefox=firefox
scripts.lint:firefox: node build.mjs dev && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/dev-firefox
